provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 NHL Conference Finals as played: in the East the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Montreal Canadiens in five (21-29 May), in the West the Vegas Golden Knights swept the Colorado Avalanche (20-26 May). Both series are one event; game N holds both series' Game N, so Game 5 is the East's alone. The field is every skater who dressed in either series, named and placed by birth country from the NHL's rosters and player pages; ranking is the skater's 2025-26 regular-season Power Play total with the club (2 per goal + assists + shots on goal). Each game's box score (goals, assists, shots on goal) is from the NHL's gamecenter boxscores, cross-checked skater by skater against ESPN's box scores, which agree on every line (ESPN names Zachary Bolduc and Joseph Veleno Zack and Joe). A skater with no goal, assist or shot in a game has an empty line.
